page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet. At top right the library logo (not transcribed). Below, a metadata block titled "Werk" with bibliographic fields. Further down, a "Terms and Conditions" block, then a "Contact" block at the foot. No text of the printed book.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. Omitted as page furniture: the library logo and the metadata block (title, author, publisher, place, year, collection, shelfmark, IDs, PURL and OPAC links), plus the Terms and Conditions and Contact blocks. The title field reads "[...] hoc est: Vexatissimarum Sacrae Scripturae Vocum, Urim Et Tummim, Verus sens..." and gives Otho, Georgius; Lombardius, Johannes as authors, Schadewitzius as publisher, Marpurgi Cattorum as place, 1680 as year. These are catalogue data, not text of the book.
